panel.title: My rental dossier
panel.description: Prepare your dossier once (details and documents), then send it in one click from a rental listing. The landlord gets a private link, valid for 30 days, that you can withdraw at any time.

profile.title: My details
profile.description: The equivalent of the German "Mieterselbstauskunft". Every field is optional.
profile.aboutPlaceholder: Introduce yourself to the landlord in a few lines.
profile.error: Could not save. Please check the fields.

documents.title: My documents
documents.description: PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB per file.
documents.privacyTip: These documents are private: only the landlords you send your dossier to can see them. Hide anything that isn't needed, such as your ID number.
documents.uploadError: Could not add the document. Please try again.
documents.tooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB.
documents.limit: You have reached the limit of {max} documents.

id.label: ID document
id.hint: Passport or ID card, both sides.

employment.label: Employment contract
employment.hint: Or a certificate from your employer, university, scholarship…

sentList.title: Sent to
sentList.description: Landlords always see the current version of your dossier. A deleted document disappears for them too.
sentList.empty: You haven't sent your dossier to any listing yet.
sentList.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

send.title: Send my rental dossier
send.description: The landlord gets a notification and a private link to your dossier, valid for 30 days.
send.empty: Your dossier is empty. Add at least one document before sending it.
send.summary: {count, plural, one {# document will be shared.} other {# documents will be shared.}}
send.messagePlaceholder: Hello, I'm very interested in your listing…
send.privacy: You can withdraw access at any time from your personal space.
send.error: Could not send the dossier. Please try again.

received.title: {count, plural, =0 {Dossiers received} one {# dossier received} other {# dossiers received}}
received.hint: Highlighted dossiers come from Premium members and are shown first.

view.confidential: Confidential documents, shared only for this application. Please do not forward them.
view.unavailableText: This link has expired or its owner withdrew access.
